Production gpt-4.1-mini makes the same premature transfers, so this is a gate-reasoning weakness of small or flash-tier models. GPT-5.4-mini is the strongest instruction-follower on the lever list and runs with reasoning_effort none. It is the candidate most likely to (a) cut premature transfers below 12, (b) deliver scripted rebuttals instead of ending early, and (c) lift action_correct (weighted x2) and reply_quality enough to clear the +0.03 quality epsilon. Predicted: quality about 0.56-0.62, premature_transfers 4-12. Main risk: latency_ms_median rises from 585 to roughly 600-700ms. Above 635ms the round reverts on the latency gate, but it would still give the first measurement of the quality ceiling, which every later model choice depends on.
